about_the_game:
Rogue Pirates is a swashbuckling roguelike turn-based RPG about adventuring on the high seas. Danger and excitement. Risk and reward. 

Grow your Pirate Legend

Recruit a team of brave and skilled pirates to crew your ship.  Chart your course and explore shipwrecks and treasure islands.  Challenge other pirates, legendary captains and even Lovecraftian inspired sea monsters in an effort to claim both treasure and increase your status as a pirate legend.  

Features

  • A Wide Variety of character classes with diverse skillsets

  • Pirate Legends System that allows your heroes to increase their legendary status

  • Procedurally generated worlds where charting the right course means balancing risk vs reward

  • Each roguelike style voyage is broken up into passages, where a boss awaits at the end of each passage

In Rogue Pirates your goal is to become a Pirate Legend. Can you successfully captain your crew through uncharted waters, navigating a hostile sea filled with both peril and plunder?

short_description: Rogue Pirates is a swashbuckling roguelike turn-based RPG about captaining your crew of pirates through hostile seas. Recruit daring pirates to join your crew and lead them into peril and plunder. Battle sea monsters, other pirates and civilization itself all for the quest of becoming a legend.
